name: navi-bench-vividseats
description: A dataset designed to evaluate agent/web-navigation performance on tasks related to the VividSeats website, measuring the ability to follow multi-step natural language instructions to find or extract ticket-related information. Tasks typically require interacting with web pages, extracting fields, and performing sequences of actions, enabling evaluation of tool-using and instruction-following models.
reputation: Small, community-shared benchmark with limited adoption beyond experimental agent/web-navigation research.
